posts.name: Prachi Palladwar
posts.cooked: i am repeating whole system command course, not oppe only so can i use my last term VM ssh-keygen or have to re-create it again and do i need to solve all BPTs again if i am using same ssh-keygen, how to proceed with BPT’s can someone please guide?

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
Prachisony:

can i use my last term VM ssh-keygen or have to re-create it again

You should still have access to your course VM and if you still have old ssh keys available under .ssh then you should still be able to connect to the VM. If you are getting any “permission denied” errors then recreate a new key and upload it on the VM Manager website.

Prachisony:

do i need to solve all BPTs again if i am using same ssh-keygen

Your BPTs have no link to what key you are using to log into the VM. Your user profile on the VM is linked to your student email ID, so as long as you are able to login it doesn’t matter. Your past term’s BPTs might be available in your se2001 directory, which you can resubmit to be eligible for the OPPE. However if you wish to, you can reattempt the BPTs from scratch.
